title: The power cut
paragraphs: The lights went out just as the class began the last part of the play. At first the hall was {{1}}, and nobody moved. Then a teacher brought a torch, and the actors continued {{2}} in its narrow beam.
The audience listened more {{3}} than usual because they could hardly see. When the power returned, the play had already {{4}}. Everyone agreed that the {{5}} had made the evening more memorable.
